name: HookSpark Request a Quote for WooCommerce
author: hookspark

sections.description:
Live demo | Compare Free and Premium

Customers collect simple products and variations in a separate quote list. A confirmation dialog and list counter show what was added. The list keeps quantities and customer details together without changing the WooCommerce shopping cart.

Store managers prepare a manual proposal with negotiated net prices, shipping, customer billing address, terms and expiry. WooCommerce calculates taxes from the confirmed address. Published revisions remain fixed. Customers use a private link to view the proposal, download its Essential PDF with the store logo, and accept or decline.

Accepting a proposal does not charge the customer or reserve stock. A separate action prepares a WooCommerce order using the accepted prices and taxes; WooCommerce handles payment. Availability is checked when preparing the order and continuing to payment.

Free includes:

  • A separate quote list for simple products and selected variations.
  • Global options to hide prices and Add to cart, with a separate server rule to prevent direct purchases of supported products.
  • Request receipts and store notifications through the site’s email transport.
  • A manager request queue, manual proposals and immutable revisions.
  • An Essential PDF layout with a local PNG or JPEG logo.
  • Private acceptance or refusal and conversion to a native WooCommerce order.
  • Private-link replacement and WordPress personal-data export and erasure callbacks.

Classic WooCommerce product loops and single-product forms are supported. Catalogue Product Collection blocks use product context for quote controls. The single-product Add to Cart with Options block is supported in block themes for simple and variable products. Quote-only product options remain available separately from direct purchasing. Verify custom themes and builders on your installed versions before launch.

This edition works locally without a HookSpark account or commercial license. Premium is a separate package with additional proposal layouts, reusable templates and detailed rules. No Premium runtime, external updater, automatic installer or telemetry is included in Free.

Dependencies and integrations

Requires WooCommerce, which manages product data, taxes and the resulting order and payment flow. Optional integrations are installed and configured separately.

Optional WordPress Abilities and MCP access

Optional AI access is disabled by default. On WordPress 6.9 or later, authorized operators can read supported configuration and prepare validated settings proposals through the WordPress Abilities API. For MCP clients, install the official WordPress MCP Adapter separately and configure a compatible client. Follow the HookSpark AI access guide.

One shared HookSpark access switch and review page serve installed participating plugins. A proposal must be approved in WordPress by the same user within 15 minutes; stale or reused proposals are rejected. The normal settings editor remains available without AI access.

The Free abilities expose storefront controls and Premium precedence only. They do not expose customer requests, proposals or merchant email addresses, and do not create requests, offers or orders.

Related free HookSpark plugins

Optional plugins, available separately on WordPress.org; neither is required or unlocks Premium integrations.

  • HookSpark Min/Max Quantities — quantity limits for WooCommerce.
  • HookSpark Dynamic Pricing & Discounts — pricing and discount rules for WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
If you previously installed the HookSpark website ZIP under hs-request-a-quote-free, deactivate that copy before activating this directory edition. Do not activate both copies together. Existing Free records and settings are retained.

  1. Install and activate WooCommerce on WordPress 6.8 or later with PHP 8.2 or later.
  2. Upload the hookspark-request-a-quote-for-woocommerce directory and activate the plugin.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Quote requests — Free to review store preferences, notification email and logo.
  4. Optionally publish a page containing [hookspraq_list] and select its page ID. Otherwise the built-in list page is used.
  5. Review your privacy policy, email delivery configuration and retention policy.
  6. Test a request, proposal, PDF, decision and order using your payment gateway’s test mode before opening the store.
sections.faq:
Is the quote list the WooCommerce cart?

No. Quote-list products and quantities are stored separately. Adding to the quote list does not place an order.

Can I hide Add to cart?

Yes. Free has global catalogue and product-page display options. Prevent direct purchases is a separate server rule for supported simple and variable products. Other product types keep their existing purchase flow.

Does accepting a quote take payment?

No. The customer subsequently creates an order and continues through WooCommerce’s payment flow. Acceptance alone does not reserve inventory.

Does sent mean the email reached the inbox?

No. It means the configured email transport accepted the message. Check delivery with your email provider. An interrupted processing event can have an uncertain outcome and is not retried automatically.

Can published prices or logos change?

Published revisions keep their prices, taxes, terms, address and logo. A new proposal creates another revision. Accepted agreements are locked.

What data is stored and removed?

The site stores contact details, selected products, messages, proposals, billing addresses, decisions, email-event records and linked order IDs. List sessions expire after two days; manager draft inputs expire after one hour. Proposals and delivery records have no automatic business-record purge. WordPress privacy tools export data and can erase unaccepted requests. Accepted agreements, linked orders and uncertain outgoing email events are retained for separate store review. WooCommerce order data must be reviewed separately. Uninstalling preserves records and clears the plugin’s scheduled jobs.

Does Free contact an external service?

The Free runtime does not send telemetry, fetch remote PDF resources or use a commercial license service. Emails use the site’s configured transport; WooCommerce gateways and other plugins may use services configured by the store.

Is an AI client required, and what data can it receive?

No. All Free quote features work without an AI client. If you enable optional access, your configured client can receive supported settings and proposals under its own privacy terms. Choose its credentials and permissions carefully. Request a Quote Free does not automatically connect to an external AI service and does not expose customer quote records through these abilities.

What happens when Premium is activated?

Premium handles new requests and Free suppresses its storefront controls. Keep Free active to manage its own historical proposals and orders. Each edition retains its own records; no automatic conversion changes accepted agreements. Keep the originating edition active to manage its historical agreements and financial protections.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Use distinctive hookspraq identifiers throughout this directory edition.
  • Preserve existing quote records, private links, saved lists, PDFs and linked orders when upgrading.
  • Existing Free quote-list shortcodes continue to render; new pages use [hookspraq_list].

1.0.4

  • Add native WordPress nonces to private proposal decision and order forms, preserving request-bound guest CSRF and authorization checks.
  • Align directory translations with WordPress.org language packs.

1.0.3

  • Preserve single-product quote controls in selected Elementor layouts. Tested versions and scope: https://hookspark.dev/request-a-quote/#compatibility

1.0.2

  • Add optional WordPress Abilities/MCP access: read supported configuration and prepare validated proposals for same-user browser approval.
  • Reuse one HookSpark AI access switch and review screen across installed plugins.
  • Configuration changes are saved only after human approval; proposals expire after 15 minutes.

1.0.0

Initial standalone Free edition: separate quote list and confirmation dialog, global catalogue rules, request management, fixed proposal revisions, Essential branded PDF, private decisions and WooCommerce order conversion. Includes privacy callbacks, access-link replacement and translation-ready strings for WordPress.org language packs. Tested with WordPress 6.8 and 7.1.2, WooCommerce 10.6.0 and 11.1.2, PHP 8.2.29; current-version order tests include HPOS. Custom themes, builders and payment gateways require store-specific testing.
